text: AI agents write code and move money. Yet payment rails cannot determine whether offchain work met the agreed scope.
ScopeSettle locks scope and settlement policy before funding an ERC-8183 escrow on X Layer.
Each deliverable binds one public pull request, its base commit, and one immutable head commit. A moving branch cannot replace the evidence.
Deterministic gates verify repository identity, required files, change bounds, and CI. The hosted evaluator scores only evidence that survives validation.
Every criterion exposes its score, reason, citations, and limitations. Deterministic code recomputes the weighted result outside the model.
On low confidence, ScopeSettle failed closed. The named reviewer rejected the verdict and refunded the valueless Testnet escrow.
The public certificate recomputes every binding, from report and rubric to evaluator and verdict. Job three verifies ten out of ten.
Open SDK and CLI checks run against X Layer RPC. Integrators never need to trust the ScopeSettle server.
The developer console adds scoped keys, signed webhooks, durable retries, and audits. ScopeSettle: verified work, automatic settlement.
